name: b2-mcp-agent-cli
description: Isolated, checked-in manifest for the Claude Code CLI used by the scheduled agent-eval and control-band workflows (#528). Kept outside the root workspace so the CLI and its per-platform native binaries are pinned with integrity hashes in this directory's own pnpm-lock.yaml (installed --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts) but never enter the shipped root lockfile or dependency budget. Run it through node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli-wrapper.cjs, which needs no postinstall.
